summary: A secure, Azure-native AI Contract Intelligence system for Apex Global Solutions to automate document extraction from commercial leases and supplier contracts. Operating within a private Azure tenant, the solution integrates SharePoint and SAP to achieve high accuracy (>=92%) and eliminate financial risks from missed notice windows.
assumptions: The system will operate exclusively within the Apex private Microsoft Azure tenant (US-East / East-US-2 regions).
Apex Global Solutions will provide the necessary API credentials and network access for SharePoint and SAP integrations.
The 15,000 historical documents provided are representative of the variation in future lease and contract types.
Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) will be available for 4 hours per week during the Discovery and UAT phases.
Compliance is grounded in SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and HIPAA standards as referenced in the source proposal.

acceptance_criteria: Post-HITL accuracy audits confirm >= 92% accuracy on a statistically significant sample of processed fields.

requirements_register.description: Eliminate financial risks from missed notice windows.

requirement_priorities.requirement_text: All model training, RAG vectorization, and execution must occur strictly within Apex's private Microsoft Azure tenant.
requirement_priorities.rationale: Data residency is a hard constraint; any external API call would violate security mandates.
Meeting the accuracy target is the primary measure of project success and ROI.

requirement_priorities.requirement_text: Export structured data to SAP/Property Management database via RESTful APIs.
requirement_priorities.rationale: The system's value is dependent on the successful transfer of data to the system of record (SAP).

risks: High error rate (12%) in existing manual data makes it difficult to establish a reliable baseline for AI training.
Strict data residency requirements prohibit the use of public LLM endpoints, requiring complex private infrastructure.
Complexity of legal phrasing in amendments may lead to missed notice windows if not properly vectorized.
Dependency on third-party SAP/SharePoint API availability for end-to-end processing.
